q.line: All your towels are getting laundered
stanza: I washed all the windows
Threw away the sheets that we used
All your towels are getting laundered
All our pictures in the desk drawer

partner.line: All our pictures in the desk drawer

q.line: Then many happy days I squandered
stanza: All 'round the little farm I wandered
When I was young
Then many happy days I squandered
Many the songs I sung
When I was playing with my brother
Happy was I
Oh, take me to my kind old mother
There let me live and die
